input.description: Retained licensed Big Buck Bunny VOD; originals unchanged; no network acquisition

options.media_key_policy: identical public test key and KID in both output configurations; no key values recorded
options.standalone_verification: fresh source and output in a separate CLI invocation after each conversion

evidence_limits: One Darwin arm64 host, three rotated matched pairs, uncontrolled filesystem cache and other host processes; load averages recorded per run. This is no universal speed guarantee.
Conversion wall timing excludes retained-input fingerprinting, output hash inspection, setup, network acquisition and the separately measured standalone verification.
CPU RUSAGE_CHILDREN totals include process-table observer subprocesses; they are not isolated drmr CPU.
RSS uses 100 ms process-table samples keyed by parent PID without process-generation proof, not a hard memory bound or an exact peak.
Workspace logical file bytes cover selected quiescent checkpoints only; incomplete checkpoints are retained in the report, not interpreted as zero.
Total physical process or filesystem I/O was not measured.
Scope duration sums overlap and do not equal wall time or CPU time.
No decoding was requested; native metadata, every sample payload and timing comparison, exact DRM declarations and native manifest lint passed for every output.
No DRM device or license-server playback was qualified. Encryption and packaging remain independent; ciphertext identity across outputs is not a criterion.
Parent and descendant RSS peaks are separate observations and must not be added as a simultaneous combined peak. No memory or disk improvement is claimed from these partial observations.
